basis: Exact indexed PDF bytes were publicly archived from NBIM before, during and after these meetings. The archived official guideline page links the same 2025 asset, and dated NBIM reports describe its actual annual guideline-based voting practice. Historical applicability for these three dates is an evidence-based inference from these independent observations, not from PDF metadata alone.
limitations: Archive captures prove availability at those instants, not a signed legal effective-from/effective-until certificate.
The existing index bounds 2025-05-13 through 2026-01-01 are operational guards; this evidence does not establish their exact effective dates or validate CCC on 2025-05-22.
Guidelines are non-binding and allow company-specific context; matching public intentions is not proof of an objective right vote.
Retrospective reports, archived policy HTML, and public vote rationales are audit evidence only; they never enter model input or the policy index.
